title: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics
title_zh: 物理信息符号回归揭示了粒子—界面动力学中的延迟振荡闭合关系
summary: 研究利用物理信息符号回归分析分层流体中颗粒穿越尖锐密度界面的高分辨率跟踪实验数据，建立了描述延迟分层诱导力的紧凑解析闭合关系。该闭合关系表现为延迟的指数衰减振荡形式，可捕捉界面记忆、尾流脱落、回弹和黏性弛豫等机制，并在瞬态丰富的情形下优于基于虚质量方程的模型。研究表明，结合时间序列实验数据、量纲约束和物理约束的符号回归能够辅助复杂流体动力学中的可解释模型发现。
abstract: Particles settling through sharply density-stratified fluids exhibit transient dynamics that remain difficult to capture with classical buoyancy–drag models, including strong deceleration, prolonged retention near the interface, and, in some cases, apparent bouncing. Existing mechanistic models that reproduce parts of this behavior through the equation of motion rely on auxiliary artificial virtual-mass ODEs whose physical interpretation and predictive generality are limited. In this study, we demonstrate implementation of physics-informed symbolic regression (PISR) method, applied to high-resolution dataset of particle-tracking experiments across stratified interface, enabling a compact analytical closure for the delayed stratification-induced force acting on spheres crossing sharp density interfaces, replacing an virtual mass ODE and capturing complex transient dynamics. Using fully resolved position-time trajectories of spheres from water–salt and water–glycerol stratified experiments, the PISR framework is designed to select a delayed, exponentially damped oscillatory force closure that is consistent with physical mechanisms of interfacial memory, wake detachment, recoil, and viscous relaxation. The resulting force closure reproduces qualitatively and quantitatively key features of the observed sphere dynamics and improves reconstruction transient-rich cases relative to a virtual-mass-based baseline. More broadly, the study demonstrates how scientist-in-the-loop or physically-informed symbolic regression (SR) can assist physical-model discovery by combining fully resolved time series experimental data, dimensional and physical constraints, and physically interpretable analytical model selection. These results provide a practical modeling framework for sphere motion across stably-stratified density interfaces and illustrate the potential of artificial intelligence assisted SR for extracting compact, testable closures in complex fluid dynamics problems.

title: Textured Si Wafer-Assisted Fabrication of Stretchable Platinum Nanotube Network Electrodes for Flexible Piezoelectric Devices
title_zh: 纹理化硅晶圆辅助制备可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极及其在柔性压电器件中的应用
summary: 研究提出了一种纹理化硅辅助的可拉伸铂纳米管网络电极制备策略，以静电纺丝聚乙烯吡咯烷酮纳米纤维作为牺牲模板，通过溅射铂形成具有连续导电通路的纤维网络。去除模板并转移至聚二甲基硅氧烷后，电极的方块电阻为7.55欧姆/方，并可承受高达100%的拉伸应变，而传统铂薄膜在弯曲和超过20%的拉伸应变下即发生失效。该电极与钛酸钡—聚二甲基硅氧烷压电复合层集成后，在25牛顿、3赫兹外力下产生约40纳安输出电流，显示出其作为柔性压电器件可变形电极平台的潜力。
abstract: Flexible and stretchable electrodes are essential components for soft electronic devices that operate under repeated mechanical deformation. However, conventional metal thin-film electrodes often suffer from crack formation and electrical failure because of the mechanical mismatch between rigid metal layers and elastomeric substrates. In this study, we present a textured Si-assisted fabrication strategy for stretchable platinum nanotube (Pt-NT) network electrodes. Electrospun polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) nanofibers on a textured Si wafer were used as sacrificial one-dimensional templates for Pt sputtering, enabling the formation of Pt-coated fibrous networks with controlled electrical continuity. Increasing the sputtering time increased the apparent Pt coating thickness and reduced the sheet resistance, indicating the development of interconnected Pt pathways. After thermal removal of the PVP template and transfer into polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), the Pt-NT electrode exhibited a low sheet resistance of 7.55 Ω sq− 1. Under mechanical deformation, the Pt thin-film electrode showed electrical failure during bending and failed above 20% tensile strain, whereas the Pt-NT electrode maintained conductive pathways even at 100% strain. The Pt-NT electrode was further integrated with a BaTiO3-PDMS piezoelectric composite layer, producing an output current of approximately 40 nA under an applied force of 25 N at 3 Hz. These results demonstrate that textured Si-assisted Pt-NT network electrodes can serve as deformable electrode platforms for flexible piezoelectric devices.

title: Late Permian core-surface-magnetosphere conditions revealed by single crystal paleointensities from the Emeishan large igneous province

summary: 该研究利用保存在约2.6亿年前辉长岩斜长石中的磁记录，探讨晚二叠世地球核心、地表环境与磁层条件。研究指出，地球磁场强度曾突然下降至当前强度的一半，但仍未弱到足以耗竭臭氧层或引发晚二叠世灭绝事件。有关古强度测定方法和地质解释的详细信息需查阅原文。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77506-z Using magnetic records preserved in plagioclase of 260-million-year-old gabbro, the study finds that Earth’s magnetic field abruptly declined to half today’s strength but remained too strong to deplete ozone or drive Late Permian extinctions.

title: A Novel Approach to Computing the Permanent Magnet Thickness in PMSMs
title_zh: 永磁同步电机中永磁体厚度计算的新方法
summary: 针对经验公式精度低以及有限元参数扫描计算永磁体厚度耗时较长的问题，本文提出了一种迭代计算方法。该方法基于初始厚度建立有限元模型，提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密，并利用计算公式迭代更新永磁体厚度。以一台1600 kW、250 r/min的U形内置式永磁同步电机为例，结果表明，该方法在保持精度的同时可将计算时间缩短约75%。
abstract: To address the low accuracy of empirical formulas and the time-consuming nature of finite-element (FE) parametric sweeps for permanent magnet (PM) thickness in permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs), a novel iterative approach for calculating the PM thickness is presented. The method first establishes a FE model using an initial thickness, extracts the leakage factor, reluctivity, and average air-gap flux density, and then iteratively updates the thickness using the calculation formula. A 1600 kW, 250 r/min U-shaped interior PMSM is taken as the test case for validation. The results indicate that the proposed method reduces the calculation time by about 75% compared to the FE parametric sweep method, and yields identical thickness results. Both electromagnetic performance analysis and prototype tests confirm that the proposed method enhances design efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, and is applicable to the fast calculation of PM thickness for PMSMs.

title: Spatial configurations in rehabilitated social housing: a relational analysis of design patterns in Brazil
title_zh: 改造型社会住房中的空间构型：巴西设计模式的关系分析
summary: 在巴西，改造中心城区闲置建筑是以更可持续且空间融合的方式提供社会住房的一种有前景但仍研究不足的途径。本文基于克里斯托弗·亚历山大的模式理论，构建关系分析框架，并通过共现关系研究设计模式在10座巴西改造建筑中的组合效应和拓扑表现。结果显示，建筑中存在联系紧密的设计核心以及跨越不同空间尺度的连接模式，表明改造社会住房中可能存在反复出现的空间语法。研究可为设计导则制定和以证据为基础的中心城区住房公共政策改进提供支持。
abstract: The rehabilitation of vacant buildings in central urban areas constitutes a promising – yet still underexplored in Brazil – alternative for delivering social housing (SH) in a more sustainable and spatially integrated manner. This article aims to characterize rehabilitated buildings through design patterns, based on the theory of Christopher Alexander, which proposes solutions oriented toward enhancing architectural and urban qualities. Initially, patterns potentially applicable to this context were identified, forming a relational analytical framework: rather than being examined in isolation, they are analyzed in terms of co-occurrence, considering their combined effects and topological performance within the design structure of buildings. Subsequently, this framework is applied to a sample of ten rehabilitated buildings in Brazil, using architectural documentation and on-site visits. Data analysis was conducted through the construction of networks in VOSviewer, complemented by centrality metrics (Degree and Betweenness Centrality) to interpret their relational structure. The results indicate the presence of strongly connected design cores and patterns that perform articulating roles across different spatial scales, suggesting the existence of a recurring spatial grammar in the context of rehabilitation. Additionally, they show that the configuration of SH produced through rehabilitation tends to result from the articulation between constructive attributes, functional organization, collective spaces, and urban insertion. This analytical reading provides support for the formulation of design guidelines and the improvement of evidence-based public policies aimed at housing provision in central urban areas.

title: Robust Broadband Dielectric Bragg Reflectors by Sensitivity-Regularized Chirp: Transfer-Matrix Proofs and Computational Uncertainty Analysis
title_zh: 文献研究：Robust Broadband Dielectric Bragg Reflectors by Sensitivity-Regularized Chirp: Transfer-Matrix Proofs and Computational Uncertainty Analysis
summary: Fabrication variability limits the degree to which broadband dielectric Bragg reflectors can realize spectra predicted by nominal quarter-wave designs. This work develops a sensitivity-regularized chi…
abstract: Fabrication variability limits the degree to which broadband dielectric Bragg reflectors can realize spectra predicted by nominal quarter-wave designs. This work develops a sensitivity-regularized chirp strategy for one-dimensional dielectric reflectors and analyzes it with an exact transfer-matrix model, explicit perturbation identities, and reproducible uncertainty simulations. A ten-period high/low-index stack centered at 1550 nm is parameterized by a three-coefficient Chebyshev chirp, allowing the optical thickness of each period to vary smoothly while remaining close to the quarter-wave condition. The design objective combines worst-band reflectance, spectral ripple, local thickness sensitivity, and profile smoothness. Four analytical results establish unimodularity of the lossless layer matrix, flux-consistent reflection bounds, an exact derivative formula for the multilayer product, and a first-order reflectance perturbation inequality. Over 1400–1700 nm, the optimized design increases nominal minimum reflectance from 0.9481 for a uniform stack to 0.9725 while reducing aggregate local thickness sensitivity by approximately 37%. In 1,000 Monte Carlo realizations with independent 0.5% layer-thickness errors truncated at ± 1.5%, the fifth-percentile minimum reflectance is 0.9683, compared with 0.9391 for the uniform design, and the standard deviation of minimum reflectance is reduced by approximately 75%. The results show that modest, smooth departures from quarter-wave periodicity can improve both broadband floor reflectance and manufacturing tolerance without adding materials or layers. The framework is intended as a transparent computational design method for thin-film and integrated-photonic reflector engineering.
